question: Why can complete favorableness of a site not be expected in every case?
premises: Complete favorableness is the desired condition for a site.
The verse considers all places or situations.
Such complete favorableness is said not to be obtained.
inference: Because complete favorableness of a site cannot be obtained everywhere, absolute suitability is not always possible.
plain_english: Because complete favorableness of a site cannot be obtained everywhere.
